claims.statement: Edward Hodo of Granite City fell down a flight of stairs at Tom Allen's saloon at about 1:40 a.m. on March 3, 1901.
claims.excerpt: Officer Schleifstein of the Central Police District saw Hodo fall down a flicht of Stairs at the saloon at 1:40 o'clock yesterday morning.

claims.statement: Police arrested Jesse Carraher, a musician employed in the saloon, pending investigation of the fall.
claims.excerpt:

notes: The printed text gives the name once as Garraher and elsewhere as Carraher; Carraher is used. Hodo's skull fracture is reported in the article but is not Allen's injury, so it is not claimed. Allen himself is not named in the incident.
